name: crawler_search
description: STORED-FEED SEARCH ONLY. Searches previously collected titles, posts and comments; does not contact X or collect fresh posts. Use crawler_search_live for a new X Latest search.

site.description: filter to one site (omit = all). News sites: globenewswire.com = press releases, news.google.com = Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ headlines, sec.gov = EDGAR filings

days.description: lookback window in days (default 30; archive reaches back to March 2025)

name: crawler_search_live
description: Queue a fresh X Latest search on the PC using its existing authenticated browser. Returns job ID promptly; use crawler_search_job_results. No posting or paid API.

maxPosts.description: Posts per query, default 30. Independent of timeline budgets.

since.description: Inclusive publication cutoff, ISO UTC or explicit offset. Web date filter plus exact timestamp filtering.

requestId.description: Required idempotency key. Reuse for retries; new key for a new collection.

name: crawler_search_profile_run
description: Queue one collection of every saved profile query. Independent per-query budget; same single-job PC queue.

maxPosts.description: Posts per query, default 30. Independent of timeline budgets.

since.description: Inclusive publication cutoff, ISO UTC or explicit offset. Web date filter plus exact timestamp filtering.

requestId.description: Required idempotency key. Reuse for retries; new key for a new collection.

name: crawler_search_job_results
description: Read-only job status, explicit collection health, and paginated individual tweets. Partial results can grow while running; read from the beginning after completion.

maxChars.description: Approximate post plus quote text budget per page. One complete post may exceed it, explicitly flagged; text is not silently cut.

name: crawler_search_profile_get
description: Read saved query strings, independent budgets and enabled state. Hourly main gathers include enabled profiles.

name: crawler_search_profile_configure
description: Set bounded per-query collection budgets or include/exclude this profile from scheduled main gathers. Does not change timeline budgets or the main gather schedule.

maxPosts.description: Posts per query, default 30. Independent of timeline budgets.

name: crawler_search_profile_posts
description: Retrieve unacknowledged new or meaningfully updated tweets, deduplicated by tweet ID for this profile and consumer. Returns a receipt. Omit cursor at each new review; use nextCursor only to page within that review. Does not acknowledge or touch alpha scan flags.

maxChars.description: Approximate post plus quote text budget per page. One complete post may exceed it, explicitly flagged; text is not silently cut.

name: crawler_search_profile_ack
description: Acknowledge exactly the tweet versions in a returned receipt AFTER successful review. A newer edit stays pending. Idempotent; never changes alpha scanner flags.

name: crawler_search_health
description: Actual per-query collection health: last success, newest publication timestamp, collected count, truncation, stale flag and explicit errors. Online PC alone does not mean fresh results.
